goal: Dashboard password migration state must never rotate an existing usable password during ordinary config loading.

acceptance_criteria.description: Loading a config with a usable PBKDF2 password preserves both password hashes even when password_change_required is true.
An explicit dashboard password reset still rotates the password and marks the generated password for change.
The WebUI closes a previously forced account dialog after the server stops reporting password warnings.

runtime_policy.explicit_rotation: allowed only through the reset-password flag or password management commands
runtime_policy.change_required_semantics: prompt the authenticated user without replacing an existing usable password
